title: US boosts funding for AFP modernization after Hegseth-Teodoro talks

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The United States will increase funding for the modernization of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), following talks between US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth and Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. in Cebu on Wednesday. The US Department of War did not disclose the amount of additional funding or specify which AFP modernization projects would benefit. “Secretary Hegseth announced an increase in the Department of War’s security cooperation funds to accelerate the Armed Forces of the Philippines’ modernization and enhance interoperability along the First Island Chain,” the department said in a readout of the meeting.
